response.sql:
WITH timing_means AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
)
SELECT
  AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_ownership_of_above_average_timings,
  AVG(t.avg_ownership - o.avg_ownership) AS mean_excess_overall_average
FROM timing_means AS t
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
WHERE t.avg_ownership > o.avg_ownership

assumptions.assumption: “Average” for comparison means the overall mean across rows with nonmissing institutional ownership; a missing announcement timing is grouped as its own timing.

alternatives.interpretation: Compare each timing’s average with the unweighted mean of the timing averages, giving each timing equal weight in the benchmark.
alternatives.sql:
WITH timing_means AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ownership) AS avg_ownership
  FROM timing_means
)
SELECT
  AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_ownership_of_above_average_timings,
  AVG(t.avg_ownership - b.avg_ownership) AS mean_excess_timing_average
FROM timing_means AS t
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE t.avg_ownership > b.avg_ownership
